approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 23 Chapter 437
 
       MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 4467-B, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to  amend  the domestic relations law and the family court
        act, in relation to establishing a living allowance  for  adults
        with developmental disabilities"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This  bill  would allow continued support payments for certain adults,
who the Court determines to have  a  developmental  disability  and  who
continue to require monetary support from one parent past the expiration
of  child  support. Such payments would begin when child support expires
at age 21 and would continue until the age of 26.  However,  as  written
the  bill  would  have  created confusion regarding the Court's determi-
nation that an adult has a developmental  disability,  as  well  as  the
applicability  of  certain child support provisions in federal and state
law. Therefore, I reached an agreement with the Legislature which artic-
ulates the limited applicability of a finding by the Court that an indi-
vidual has a developmental disability for the sole purpose of issuing an
adult support order, as well as carving out child  support  requirements
and enforcement provisions inconsistent with federal law.
 
  I  agree  with  the intent of this bill, which provides an opportunity
for custodial  parents  to  seek  continued  support  from  noncustodial
parents  while  continuing  to house and financially support a dependent
with a disability who is unable to live on his or her own.
 
  With these agreed upon changes, I am pleased to sign this bill.
 
  The bill is approved.                          (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Relates to support orders for adult dependents; provides that a person who would otherwise be chargeable under law with support of a minor child is also chargeable with the support of any such individual until such individual reaches the age of 26, when it appears to the satisfaction of the court that such person is developmentally disabled as defined in section 1.03 of the mental hygiene law.
title: Relates to support orders for adult dependents
